en.headline: Government tenders Jardine's Lookout site for EV fast charging
en.dek: Inland Lot No. 9105 at 137 Tai Hang Road, covering 901.3 square metres, is being sold for conversion into an electric-vehicle fast charging station, with tenders closing on 6 November.
body: The government announced on Friday that it is putting Inland Lot No. 9105 at 137 Tai Hang Road, Jardine's Lookout, out to public tender for conversion into an electric-vehicle fast charging station. The invitation closes on 6 November 2026.

An Environment and Ecology Bureau spokesperson said the sale follows the updated Hong Kong Roadmap on Popularisation of Electric Vehicles issued in February, which sets a goal of zero vehicular emissions before 2050 and calls for a public charging network built around fast chargers. The government has already tendered six petrol filling station sites for fast charging and one site for combined fast charging and liquefied petroleum gas filling.

The lot measures 901.3 square metres and is designated solely for a fast charging station. Tender documents are available on the Lands Department website, and the sale plan can be inspected until the close of tender. Particulars were gazetted on Friday.

Operators of designated fast charging stations will not be allowed to charge electric taxis and electric public light buses above a monthly ceiling set by the Environmental Protection Department. Prices for other electric vehicles will be set by the market. Ceiling prices will be posted at the stations and published on the department's website once the facilities open.

zh.headline: 政府招標出售渣甸山地皮作電動車高速充電站
zh.dek: 大坑道137號內地段第9105號面積901.3平方米，指定改作電動車高速充電站，公開招標於11月6日截標。
body: 政府周五公布，公開招標出售位於渣甸山大坑道137號的內地段第9105號，用作改建成電動車高速充電站，截標日期為2026年11月6日。
環境及生態局發言人表示，是次出售配合今年2月公布的《香港電動車普及化路線圖更新版》，目標在2050年前達致車輛零排放，並以高速充電樁為骨幹建設公共充電網絡。政府已公開招標六幅油站用地作高速充電站，以及一幅用地作高速充電兼石油氣加氣站。
該幅用地面積901.3平方米，指定作電動車高速充電站。賣地文件已上載地政總署網站，賣地圖則可供查閱至截標。招標詳情同日刊憲。
指定高速充電站營運商向電動的士及電動公共小巴收取的費用，不得高於環保署每月公布的上限價格，其他電動車收費則由市場醮定。上限價格會在充電站投入服務後於場內張貼，並定期在環保署網站公布。
